fr.title: VIDÉO. Cabaret vert 2026. « C’est un rêve d’adolescent qui se concrétise » : le rappeur de Sedan Jeri a électrisé le festival
fr.description: Lecture zen Le rappeur sedanais Jeri s’est produit sur la scène Greenfloor du Cabaret vert, ce dimanche 23 août 2026. - Loris Trullard Ça fait des années qu’il attend ce moment. Ce dimanche 23 août 2026, le rappeur de Sedan qui officie sous le nom de Jeri s’est produit sur la scène Greenfloor au festival du Cabaret vert. Rencontré quelques minutes avant le concert , alors en plein réglage technique, Jeri s’est confié à L’Ardennais : « C’est la première fois que je me produis au Cabaret vert , c’est ma plus grosse scène à l’heure actuelle. » Dans la foule, parmi les premiers arrivants, des têtes bien connues de Jeri : tante, nièce, amis et bien sûr père et mère de l’artiste sont aux premières loges. « On est venus soutenir Jeri ! », nous indique Nathalie Massin, la maman. Pour encourager pleinement l’enfant prodige, toute la petite famille est habillée de t-shirts à l’effigie de l’artiste, dédicacés par ses soins et avec la mention « Sedan Zoo », le nom de son dernier EP – petit album composé de quelques morceaux. Le concert de Jeri a duré 40 minutes. - Loris Trullard Pour Jérôme, le père, la présence de son fils au Cabaret vert est le résultat « du travail fourni depuis des années, c’est un aboutissement et on espère que ça puisse lui ouvrir des portes ». En plus de cet investissement en studio, Jeri a également été bénévole pendant plusieurs années pour le festival ardennais. Cette année, si le Sedanais est à l’affiche du Cabaret vert, c’est grâce à un tremplin musical organisé pour promouvoir les artistes émergents du Grand Est. 40 minutes de show Les tests de micros, de lumières et du son une fois effectués, Jeri indique : « J’ai qu’une hâte, c’est de commencer ! Le stress commence à monter, mais c’est du bon stress . » Face à lui, le public commence à se regrouper en masse devant la scène Greenfloor. Toute la famille de Jeri, très fière, était là pour encourager l’artiste. - Loris Trullard Quelques minutes plus tard, l’horloge numérique annonce 16h50 en coulisses. C’est le moment ! La musique d’introduction se lance. Le sourire aux lèvres, le regard concentré, le rappeur enlace une dernière fois les membres de son équipe, notamment Mãyã, qui l’accompagnera durant quelques morceaux au chant. Jeri a notamment défendu sur scène son EP « Sedan Zoo ». - Loris Trullard Micro en main, Jeri se lance sur la scène et fait face à des centaines de personnes. Les morceaux s’enchaînent, les spectateurs dansent, applaudissent et encouragent l’artiste ardennais. Les premiers textes sont chantés avec quelques légères crispations, très vite estompées face à l’engouement du public. Le rappeur prend un peu plus ses marques à chaque nouvelle chanson. Il faut dire que le trentenaire commence à être habitué des scènes : il a notamment assuré les premières parties de Seth Gueko et de Svinkels, groupe de hip-hop français. « Un rêve éveillé » Wall of death – un mur de la mort, pratique en concert où la foule s’écarte en deux parties qui se foncent ensuite dessus –, échanges avec le public, sortie de scène pour chanter en fosse, Jeri a veillé à ce que les 40 minutes de son concert soient un vrai show, à en faire rougir certaines têtes d’affiche. Des centaines de personnes étaient présentes pour asisster au concert de l’artiste sedanais. - Loris Trullard Le dernier morceau terminé, Jeri rentre en coulisses et félicite toute son équipe. « C’était intense , c’était trop bien. C’est un rêve éveillé, un rêve d’adolescent qui se concrétise ! », réagit-il à L’Ardennais , à chaud. Un premier rêve accompli, maintenant place à un repos bien mérité pour l’artiste sedanais, après ce concert déjà marquant pour sa carrière. Mis en ligne le 23/08/2026 à 21:33 VIDÉO. gr.title: Σπουδαίος συμβολισμός από τον Αστέρα AKTOR: Αφιερωμένη στη μάχη κατά του καρκίνου του μαστού η τρίτη εμφάνιση [εικόνες]
gr.description: Σε μία ακόμη αξιόλογη δράση με ισχυρό κοινωνικό χαρακτήρα προχωρά ο Αστέρας AKTOR , ο οποίος αφιερώνει ολόκληρη τη σεζόν 2026-2027 στην ευαισθητοποίηση και την προσπάθεια αντιμετώπισης του Καρκίνου του Μαστού. Ο Αστέρας AKTOR προχωρά σε μία ακόμη δράση με ιδιαίτερη κοινωνική σημασία, επιλέγοντας αυτή τη φορά να στρέψει τη δύναμη και τη φωνή του στη μάχη κατά του Καρκίνου του Μαστού. Δεν είναι η πρώτη φορά που ο σύλλογος της Τρίπολης χρησιμοποιεί την παρουσία και την απήχησή του για να στηρίξει σημαντικά κοινωνικά ζητήματα. Τα προηγούμενα χρόνια έχει συμμετάσχει σε πρωτοβουλίες που αφορούν την καταπολέμηση του Παιδικού Καρκίνου, την προστασία του Περιβάλλοντος, αλλά και την ενημέρωση και ευαισθητοποίηση σχετικά με τον Αυτισμό. Ξεχωριστό κομμάτι της φετινής πρωτοβουλίας αποτελεί η τρίτη εμφάνιση του Αστέρα AKTOR. Η φανέλα είναι λευκή και φέρει το χαρακτηριστικό ροζ σύμβολο του Καρκίνου του Μαστού, στέλνοντας μήνυμα συμπαράστασης στις γυναίκες που δίνουν τη συγκεκριμένη μάχη σε ολόκληρο τον κόσμο. Αστέρας AKTOR: Σπουδαία κίνηση από τους Αρκάδες Η ΠΑΕ της Τρίπολης έγραψε στην ενημέρωσή της: «Τη σεζόν 2026-2027, ο ASTERAS AKTOR αφιερώνει τη δύναμη και τη φωνή του σε μία ακόμη σπουδαία μάχη: Στη μάχη κατά του Καρκίνου του Μαστού. Ο ASTERAS AKTOR, πιστός στις αρχές και τις αξίες του! Για εμάς το ποδόσφαιρο είναι δύναμη, ενότητα, αλληλεγγύη και πάνω απ’ όλα ευθύνη απέναντι στην κοινωνία. Όλα αυτά τα χρόνια, ο ASTERAS AKTOR επιλέγει να βρίσκεται εκεί όπου υπάρχει ανάγκη. Να ενημερώνει, να ευαισθητοποιεί, να στηρίζει και να στέλνει μέσα από τη δύναμη του αθλητισμού μηνύματα που μπορούν να κάνουν τη διαφορά. Δώσαμε τη μάχη κατά του Παιδικού Καρκίνου. Σταθήκαμε στη μάχη για την προστασία του Περιβάλλοντος. Ενώσαμε τη φωνή μας στη μάχη για την ενημέρωση, την αποδοχή και την ευαισθητοποίηση για τον Αυτισμό. Και συνεχίζουμε! Τη σεζόν 2026-2027, ο ASTERAS AKTOR αφιερώνει τη δύναμη και τη φωνή του σε μία ακόμη σπουδαία μάχη: Στη μάχη κατά του Καρκίνου του Μαστού. Η λευκή εμφάνιση της ομάδας μας, με το ροζ σύμβολο τυπωμένο επάνω της, αφιερώνεται στη σπουδαία μάχη που δίνουν οι γυναίκες σε όλο τον κόσμο. Θα αγωνιζόμαστε, όλες οι ομάδες μας, οι ανδρικές, οι Ακαδημίες και ασφαλώς η γυναικεία και η δύναμή μας θα γίνεται δύναμή τους! Θα συμβάλουμε κι εμείς, με τον δικό μας τρόπο, ώστε το μήνυμα να φτάσει όσο πιο μακριά γίνεται. Για κάθε γυναίκα που δίνει τη δική της μάχη. Για κάθε οικογένεια που στέκεται δίπλα της. Για όλες εκείνες που πάλεψαν και νίκησαν. Για την πρόληψη. Για την ενημέρωση. Για τη ζωή. Μαζί πιο δυνατοί! mx.title: Empresarios piden Gobernador sustituto con experiencia y capacidad para dar certeza a Sinaloa
mx.description: CULIACÁN._ Ante la incertidumbre política que atraviesa Sinaloa, el Consejo Intercamaral de Culiacán llamó al Congreso del Estado a valorar, ante una eventual sustitución del Gobernador, la designación de una persona con experiencia, capacidad de liderazgo y conocimiento de la realidad estatal. A través de un posicionamiento dirigido a los diputados del Congreso de Sinaloa, el organismo empresarial señaló que las decisiones que se tomen en materia de gobernabilidad deben estar orientadas a recuperar la certeza, estabilidad y confianza de los ciudadanos, del sector empresarial y de los sectores productivos. “En este contexto, hacemos un llamado enérgico a las autoridades competentes para que, ante la eventual necesidad de relevar al titular del Poder Ejecutivo Estatal, se valore la designación de un Gobernador Sustituto, y no simplemente de un Gobernador Interino”, planteó. El Consejo Intercamaral sostuvo que Sinaloa requiere una persona que llegue al Gobierno estatal con capacidad, experiencia, estabilidad, liderazgo y solvencia para tomar decisiones, generar acuerdos y conducir a la entidad durante una etapa que requiere certidumbre y confianza. El llamado ocurre después de la reciente reincorporación de Rubén Rocha Moya a sus funciones como Gobernador y de la posterior solicitud de una nueva licencia al cargo, aprobada este domingo por unanimidad por la Diputación Permanente del Congreso del Estado. El sector empresarial advirtió que no es momento para improvisaciones ni decisiones de corto plazo, sino para actuar con responsabilidad y visión de Estado. De acuerdo con el Consejo Intercamaral, el sector productivo necesita condiciones de seguridad, certidumbre jurídica, estabilidad económica y confianza para continuar invirtiendo, generar empleos y contribuir al desarrollo de Sinaloa. Asimismo, sostuvo que la sociedad sinaloense merece un Gobierno que transmita tranquilidad, capacidad y rumbo. Por ello, pidió a quienes participen en la decisión sobre el futuro del Poder Ejecutivo estatal conducir el proceso con absoluta responsabilidad y procurar que quien eventualmente asuma la titularidad del Gobierno cuente con experiencia, capacidad de diálogo, liderazgo y compromiso con Sinaloa. “El momento que vivimos exige privilegiar el interés superior del Estado”, manifestó el organismo. El Consejo Intercamaral de Culiacán concluyó su posicionamiento con un llamado a recuperar la estabilidad y construir acuerdos ante la coyuntura política que atraviesa la entidad. “Sinaloa necesita certeza. Sinaloa necesita estabilidad. Sinaloa necesita un liderazgo capaz de construir acuerdos y dar resultados”, afirmó. El posicionamiento es respaldado por organismos empresariales y cámaras integrantes del Consejo Intercamaral de Culiacán, entre ellos AMMJE, AMPI, Canaco, Canacintra, Canadevi, CMIC, Canirac, Asepace, Adas y otros organismos del sector productivo.

mx.title: MC exige que nuevo Gobernador de Sinaloa rompa con el ‘rochismo’
mx.description: CULIACÁN._ Movimiento Ciudadano rechazó que el próximo Gobernador o Gobernadora de Sinaloa represente una continuidad del proyecto político de Rubén Rocha Moya y exigió que el Congreso del Estado elija un perfil que implique un cambio para la entidad. Sergio “Pío” Esquer Peiro, coordinador estatal del partido, sostuvo que el nuevo titular del Poder Ejecutivo debe ser una persona ajena al llamado “rochismo” y capaz de atender los principales problemas que enfrenta Sinaloa, particularmente la inseguridad, la pérdida de empleos, la crisis del campo, la educación y la salud. “Lo primero que tiene que ser cuando se elige el nuevo Gobernador o Gobernadora es que no represente el continuismo de Rocha, porque es lo que nos tiene hundidos”, afirmó. Esquer Peiroi cuestionó además el periodo de 112 días en que Rocha Moya permaneció separado formalmente del cargo y sostuvo que, desde la perspectiva de Movimiento Ciudadano, su ausencia no significó un cambio en la conducción política del estado. “Fue un engaño esto que pasó en estos 112 días que estuvo ausente el Gobernador y siguió mandando y en Sinaloa no se resolvió nada”, acusó. Ante la posibilidad de que el Congreso tenga que definir quién estará al frente del Gobierno de Sinaloa, el dirigente de MC pidió a los diputados actuar con responsabilidad y elegir el mejor perfil para la entidad. Planteó que quien llegue a la Gubernatura deberá tener capacidad de liderazgo y rodearse de especialistas para enfrentar los problemas del estado. “Necesitamos tener un cambio radical, un cambio radical con un perfil verdadero que merezcamos los sinaloenses”, expresó. Sobre el posicionamiento de Morena, que se deslindó de la decisión personal de Rocha Moya de reincorporarse al cargo, Esquer Peiro consideró que dicho pronunciamiento resulta insuficiente. Afirmó que Morena tiene responsabilidad política por la situación que atraviesa Sinaloa y cuestionó que, pese a contar con influencia en las principales instituciones del País, no se haya impulsado hasta ahora un juicio político contra el Gobernador. “Era para que ya hubieran iniciado un juicio, por lo menos ya el juicio político y el desafuero para que enfrente un proceso”, sostuvo. Para Movimiento Ciudadano, agregó, el deslinde de Morena representa una burla para los sinaloenses, por lo que el partido continuará vigilando el proceso y señalando públicamente cualquier intento de mantener el actual proyecto político en el Gobierno estatal.

co.title: Yeison Jiménez y Pipe Bueno: la polémica anécdota de una noche marcada por el alcohol
co.description: Authored by dsifontes Image Colprensa Domingo, 23 de Agosto de 2026 El pasado 19 de agosto, en el más reciente capítulo del pódcast Los hombres sí lloran, conducido por Juan Pablo Raba, el reconocido cantante de música popular Pipe Bueno habló abiertamente sobre los problemas de adicción y depresión que enfrentó durante su estancia en México. El artista, visiblemente reflexivo, reconoció en diálogo con Raba que durante una etapa de su vida recurrió constantemente al alcohol para afrontar distintas emociones. “Si estaba contento, bebía; si estaba aburrido, bebía”, explicó, al señalar que no sabía gestionar lo que sentía y que atravesó una fuerte crisis emocional. Uno de los momentos más complejos ocurrió después de que él y Luisa Fernanda W decidieran mudarse a México. Pipe recordó que comenzaron a surgir diferencias relacionadas con la decisión de cambiar de país. Mientras él consideraba que el traslado había sido una decisión tomada por ambos, ella sostenía que lo había hecho principalmente por él. “En algún momento mi esposa me dijo: ‘Me vine por ti’, y yo le decía: ‘No, nos vinimos por los dos’”, relató el artista. Aunque hoy asegura que puede ver la situación de otra manera, confesó que en ese momento aquellas palabras lo afectaron profundamente y lo llevaron a cuestionarse sus propias decisiones. Puede leer: Sebastián Osorio, el último Aureliano en ‘Cien años de soledad’ Desde entonces, la confesión de Pipe Bueno ha generado opiniones divididas , pero también ha hecho que vuelva a circular un episodio que Yeison Jiménez narró durante una entrevista con Eva Rey y en el que recordó una noche marcada por los excesos con el alcohol. Yeison Jiménez recordó una peligrosa borrachera con Pipe Bueno En el clip, que se ha viralizado nuevamente , se observa al fallecido cantante de música popular Yeison Jiménez narrando el incidente en tono jocoso. “Una vez tiramos a Francy en la cama, le tapamos la nariz y le pusimos una botella en la boca. Casi la matamos a punta de whisky: ella empezó a vomitar y a botar agua por la nariz y la boca”. El registro hace parte de una entrevista más amplia que Jiménez concedió a la periodista española Eva Rey , en la que recordó esta anécdota ocurrida en República Dominicana. “Todos estábamos borrachos. Con Pipe he hecho muchas locuras”, agregó el artista. La anécdota, más allá del tono humorístico con el que fue relatada, ha suscitado críticas y reflexiones en redes sociales por los riesgos que puede implicar una relación descontrolada con el alcohol, especialmente cuando el consumo excesivo puede poner en peligro la integridad de quienes participan. in.title: Adokiye Attracts Timbaland’s Attention as Nigerian Singer Enters $100,000 US Music Competition
in.source: Brand Icon Image - Latest Brand, Tech And Business
in.description: Sola Benson Nigerian singer Adokiye is gaining fresh international attention after reportedly attracting the notice of American music producer and music mogul Timbaland , in a development that has placed her among Nigerian artistes making moves on the global music scene. The recognition comes shortly after the singer released her latest self-titled single, “ADOKIYE,” as she continues to promote her music through performances and engagements in Nigeria and abroad. Her growing profile has now been linked to a $100,000 music competition in the United States , reportedly making her the first Nigerian artiste recognised in connection with the competition. The development represents a potentially significant step in Adokiye’s career, particularly as she continues to explore unconventional ways of taking her music directly to audiences. Taking the Music to the Streets Unlike artistes who rely primarily on traditional promotional channels, Adokiye has adopted a more direct approach, taking her performances to public spaces and meeting audiences where they are. Her determination was recently on display in the United Kingdom, where she performed on the streets for passersby. One of the most notable moments came outside Euston Station in London , where the singer performed without a microphone, speakers or the elaborate equipment usually associated with live music performances. Standing before commuters and other passersby, Adokiye delivered her performance at full voice. The simplicity of the performance did not stop people from paying attention. Instead, her raw vocals and evident passion drew the interest of those around her, with members of the audience applauding her performance. For Adokiye, the moment represented more than a street performance. It demonstrated her willingness to put herself before an audience, regardless of the setting or the absence of conventional stage equipment. From London Streets to International Attention The Euston Station performance has since emerged as one of the memorable moments in the singer's current musical journey. It came at a time when her activities were beginning to attract attention outside Nigeria and the United Kingdom. Her reported recognition by Timbaland adds another layer to that growing international exposure. Timbaland is widely regarded as one of the most influential American music producers of his generation, having worked with some of the biggest names in global music. For a Nigerian artiste seeking to break into wider international markets, being noticed by a figure of his stature could provide valuable exposure. Adokiye's connection to the $100,000 music competition in the United States could also create another opportunity for her to introduce her music to a broader audience. A New Chapter for Adokiye The development follows the release of her self-titled single, “ADOKIYE,” which marks another phase in her artistic journey. By combining recorded music with unconventional live performances, the singer appears determined to build her audience through direct engagement rather than relying solely on established industry structures. Her street performance in London particularly underscored that approach. With no microphone, speakers or stage, she relied on her voice and ability to command attention. The response from passersby showed that a performer does not always need a conventional stage to create a memorable musical moment. As Adokiye continues to pursue opportunities in Nigeria, the UK and the United States, her reported recognition by Timbaland and involvement in the $100,000 competition could represent an important milestone in her bid to establish a stronger international presence. For the Nigerian singer, the journey from performing for strangers outside a London railway station to attracting the attention of an American music heavyweight illustrates the increasingly unpredictable routes through which emerging artistes can find global recognition.

in.title: Taiwo Hassan ‘Ogogo’: The Remarkable Journey of a Yoruba Cinema Icon
in.source: Brand Icon Image - Latest Brand, Tech And Business
in.description: 40 facts about the veteran actor whose four-decade career transformed him from automobile mechanic to one of Yoruba cinema’s enduring stars. For more than four decades, Taiwo Hassan, popularly known as Ogogo, remained one of the most recognisable figures in Yoruba-language cinema, building a career that stretched from the theatre stage to major Nollywood productions. His death on Sunday, August 23, 2026, at the age of 66, following a battle with cancer, has brought to a close a remarkable story of perseverance, reinvention and devotion to the performing arts. His daughter, Kira Taiwo, confirmed his death during an emotional live session, five days after the family had dismissed an earlier report of his death as false. But before the fame, the movie sets and the recognition that came with becoming one of the defining faces of Yoruba cinema, Hassan was an automobile mechanic and government worker who had to make a difficult choice between the security of civil service and his passion for acting. Born on October 31, 1959, in Ilaro, Ogun State, Hassan grew up in a family deeply connected to Yoruba culture. He later trained as an automobile mechanic and worked with the Lagos State Water Corporation while developing his acting career. His journey from repairing automobiles to commanding the screen was neither sudden nor accidental. It was built through years of stage performances, cultural knowledge, persistence and a willingness to sacrifice the security of a government job for an uncertain career in entertainment. From the Workshop to the Stage Hassan’s early professional life was far removed from the glitz and glamour of Nollywood. After receiving technical training as an automobile mechanic, he secured employment with the Lagos State Water Corporation. However, acting had already begun to pull him in another direction. His involvement in theatre developed in the early 1980s under the tutelage of theatre practitioner Awo Ademola Fagbemi. He began with stage performances, gaining practical experience rather than following the conventional route of studying theatre arts. His cultural upbringing also gave him an advantage. Growing up within a Yoruba cultural environment, Hassan was familiar with oriki , the traditional praise poetry used to celebrate individuals, families and communities. His ability to chant and perform praise poetry eventually became one of the skills that distinguished him in the theatre. In a later interview, he recalled beginning his theatrical journey as an “Akide Oba” — a person who eulogises a king. That early exposure to traditional performance would become an important foundation for the characterisations that later defined his screen career. The Difficult Choice For years, Hassan maintained two careers simultaneously. By day, he was a government employee. Outside his official duties, he was an actor participating in stage productions and developing his reputation within the theatre community. The arrangement eventually became increasingly difficult to sustain as acting engagements demanded more of his time. After about 13 years with the Water Corporation, Hassan made the defining decision of his professional life in 1994: he left the government job and committed himself fully to acting and filmmaking. It was a considerable gamble at a time when Nigeria’s film industry had yet to become the huge commercial enterprise it would later become. But the decision paid off. Hassan went on to establish himself as an actor, producer, director and screenwriter, becoming one of the enduring names in Yoruba-language cinema. The Rise of ‘Ogogo’ The name Ogogo eventually became almost as famous as Taiwo Hassan himself. For Hassan, however, it was not simply a stage name invented for the entertainment industry. It was connected to his family’s oriki . The name “Ogogo” became inseparable from his professional identity, helping distinguish him from the many actors who emerged during the formative years of modern Yoruba home-video production. His rise also coincided with the development of a new generation of Yoruba filmmakers and performers. Hassan became associated with notable actors including Yinka Quadri, Abbey Lanre and Rasaq Ajao. Their collective involvement in theatre and film contributed to the growth of the Yoruba home-video movement. The emergence of groups such as the Odunfa Caucus helped create a network of performers and filmmakers who would go on to play significant roles in shaping Yoruba cinema. A Career Spanning Generations Ogogo’s career lasted more than four decades, taking him from stage performances in the early 1980s to prominent roles in contemporary Nollywood productions. He featured in numerous films, with reports and past interviews putting his appearances at well over 100 productions and, by his own account, around 300 movies. His filmography included titles such as Owo Blow , Agbelebu , Danfo Driver , Ekun-Ayo , Omo Ghetto , Òmìn , Elewon , Tenant of the House and Aníkúlápó . He was also involved in filmmaking beyond acting, working as a producer, director and screenwriter. His ability to operate on both sides of the camera reflected the breadth of his experience and his understanding of the Yoruba theatre tradition from which he emerged. ‘Aníkúlápó’ and a New Generation One of the most significant chapters of Ogogo’s later career came with his appearance in Kunle Afolayan’s Aníkúlápó . His portrayal of Alaafin Ademuyiwa introduced him to audiences beyond the traditional Yoruba-film audience and demonstrated that his appeal had survived the changing tastes of Nigeria’s entertainment industry. He later reprised the character in Aníkúlápó: Rise of the Spectre . His performance in the original film earned him a nomination for Best Supporting Actor at the 2023 Africa Magic Viewers’ Choice Awards. The role was symbolic of his career: an actor whose roots were firmly planted in Yoruba theatre and culture, but whose work continued to find relevance with a younger and broader audience. More Than an Actor Ogogo’s influence was not limited to his performances. He was deeply interested in the preservation and promotion of Yoruba culture and had spoken about the need to use television and film to showcase the richness of Yoruba traditions. He also gave back to his childhood community in Ilaro, including donating a borehole to his former primary school, Christ Church School. These efforts reflected an aspect of his career that went beyond entertainment — a desire to keep cultural identity alive while using the platform provided by the film industry to reach wider audiences. 40 Facts About Taiwo Hassan ‘Ogogo’ 1. He was 66 when he died. Hassan was born on October 31, 1959, in Ilaro, Ogun State, and died on August 23, 2026, following a battle with cancer. 2. He was a twin. Hassan was born as one of a set of twins, with his twin brother identified as Kehinde Hassan. 3. Twinhood ran through his family. Accounts of his family history indicate that his grandfather and father were also twins, while his mother reportedly gave birth to twins on four occasions. 4. He started out as an automobile mechanic. Before becoming a household name, Hassan received technical training and worked as a mechanic. 5. He worked for the Lagos State Water Corporation. His government employment provided financial stability while he continued pursuing acting. 6. He was already acting while working as a mechanic. His acting career developed alongside his employment rather than beginning only after he left government service. 7. He spent years balancing two careers. Hassan combined his civil-service responsibilities with stage performances and other acting engagements. 8. He eventually chose acting over job security. In 1994, after years with the Water Corporation, he left the job to concentrate on acting and filmmaking. 9. His acting career was rooted in theatre. He received practical theatre training under Awo Ademola Fagbemi and developed his craft through stage performances. 10. Yoruba culture shaped his acting identity. His upbringing exposed him to traditional forms of expression, including praise poetry and chanting. 11. His ability to chant oriki became an advantage. His mastery of Yoruba praise poetry helped him fit naturally into traditional roles and theatrical performances. 12. He became one of Yoruba cinema’s defining faces. His commanding performances made him one of the most recognisable actors in the Yoruba-language film industry. 13. His career lasted roughly 45 years. From his early acting years in the 1980s until his death in 2026, Hassan remained connected to acting and filmmaking for more than four decades. 14. He reportedly appeared in hundreds of films. Hassan once said in an interview that he had featured in about 300 movies. 15. His filmography crossed generations. His works included Owo Blow , Omo Ghetto , Òmìn , Elewon , Tenant of the House and Aníkúlápó , among others. 16. He was more than an actor. Hassan also worked as a producer, director and screenwriter. 17. He played Alaafin Ademuyiwa in Aníkúlápó . The role became one of the most prominent performances of his later career. 18. He returned as Alaafin Ademuyiwa in the series. He reprised the character in Aníkúlápó: Rise of the Spectre . 19. He received an AMVCA nomination. His performance in Aníkúlápó earned him a 2023 Africa Magic Viewers’ Choice Awards nomination for Best Supporting Actor. 20. He remained active well into his sixties. Unlike many performers who gradually stepped away from the industry, Hassan continued working into the later years of his life. 21. Acting was a passion before it became a profession. His involvement with theatre began while he was still employed outside the entertainment industry. 22. Acting eventually became too demanding to combine with government work. Productions and theatre commitments increasingly made it difficult for him to maintain both careers. 23. He resigned rather than abandon acting. Hassan ultimately chose to leave his government position and pursue entertainment full-time. 24. He reportedly rose through the ranks at the Water Corporation. Accounts of his time there indicate that he had attained a senior craftsman level before leaving. 25. He became known for powerful roles. Ogogo frequently portrayed authoritative, tough and traditional characters, performances that became part of his screen identity. 26. His nickname became his brand. For generations of movie lovers, “Ogogo” became more familiar than his birth name. 27. He was passionate about Yoruba cultural preservation. Hassan consistently expressed interest in using entertainment to promote Yoruba culture and values. 28. He once discussed plans for a Yoruba cultural television programme. He envisioned a programme that would present Yoruba traditions and culture to audiences around the world. 29. He contributed to his community. Among his community-oriented efforts was the donation of a borehole to his former primary school in Ilaro. 30. His career was a dramatic reinvention. He moved from automobile repair and government employment to theatre, film acting, production and directing. 31. He never seriously considered abandoning acting. In a 2015 interview, Hassan said the thought of quitting acting had never crossed his mind. 32. Persistence defined his rise. He spent years performing on stage and combining acting with government employment before taking the leap into full-time entertainment. 33. He worked into an age when many entertainers would have retired. His career remained active into 2026, demonstrating his continued attachment to the industry. 34. His final days were marked by a public health crisis. His daughters, Lima and Kira Taiwo, made emotional appeals for medical assistance after revealing that he was battling stage-four cancer. 35. The family said they only recently discovered the severity of his condition. Lima reportedly said the family became aware of the seriousness of his illness about three weeks before their public appeals, adding that his outward appearance had initially concealed how ill he was. 36. The family initially sought medical help rather than financial donations. The appeals focused on finding hospitals, specialists and appropriate medical care for the veteran actor. 37. His illness triggered widespread concern. Fans, colleagues and members of the public rallied around the family after his daughters publicly sought help. 38. His death was preceded by a false death report. On August 18, his daughter Lima dismissed a viral report claiming that the actor had died, calling it fake. 39. His eventual death came only days after that denial. The family had rejected the earlier report as false before Kira later confirmed his death on August 23. 40. His story was ultimately one of reinvention. From an automobile mechanic and civil servant to a stage performer, actor, producer, director and screenwriter, Taiwo Hassan built a legacy that became deeply intertwined with the history of Yoruba cinema. A Legacy Beyond the Screen Ogogo’s passing represents the loss of an actor whose career mirrored the evolution of Yoruba-language cinema itself. He belonged to a generation that moved from traditional theatre to the home-video era and, ultimately, into the modern streaming age. His career survived those transformations because he remained connected to the cultural foundations that first shaped him. His journey also offered an unusual lesson in professional courage. Hassan did not enter the entertainment industry with the certainty that it would provide the financial security of government employment. Instead, he spent years combining both worlds before eventually choosing the uncertain path of acting. That decision transformed him from a mechanic and civil servant into one of the most recognisable names in Nigerian indigenous-language cinema. For generations of viewers, the name Ogogo will remain associated with powerful performances, Yoruba cultural expression and a career that refused to be confined to a single era of Nollywood. His death may have ended the journey, but the body of work he left behind ensures that the journey itself will remain part of the history of Nigerian cinema.

sa.description: شهد ولي العهد السعودي، رئيس مجلس الوزراء، الأمير محمد بن سلمان، حفل تتويج أبطال كأس العالم للرياضات الإلكترونية 2026 في باريس، بحضور الرئيس الفرنسي، إيمانويل ماكرون، في القصر الكبير، وذلك في إطار زيارة الدولة التي يجريها ولي العهد إلى فرنسا. وتوج الرئيس الفرنسي إيمانويل ماكرون فريق AG. AL ( "اُوْل جيمرز جلوبال) بلقب كأس العالم للرياضات الإلكترونية، الذي يعد حدثاً رياضياً سنوياً واحتفال عالمي بالتنافسية والتميز في مجال الرياضات الإلكترونية، وتحتضنه باريس للمرة الأولى، وذلك بعد سبعة أسابيع من المنافسات الرياضية. ويجسد حضور ولي العهد السعودي، الأمير محمد بن سلمان حفل اختتام البطولة امتداداً لدعمه المستمر لقطاع الألعاب والرياضات الإلكترونية، كما يعكس عمق العلاقات السعودية الفرنسية وحرص البلدين المشترك على توظيف الرياضة والثقافة والقطاعات الإبداعية لتعزيز التعاون والشراكة بينهما.وتصدر الفريق المتوج الترتيب العام للبطولة برصيد 5,300 نقطة، ليحصد الجائزة الكبرى البالغة قيمتها 7 ملايين دولار أمريكي، من إجمالي جوائز البطولة التي تجاوزت 75 مليون دولار أمريكي، كأكبر مجموع جوائز في تاريخ قطاع

za.title: When accountability has no number
za.description: “Who ya gonna call?” was an easy question in Ghostbusters. In the movie, if there was something strange in the neighbourhood, you knew exactly who to call, and even more importantly, somebody would answer and respond. In South Africa, considerably less supernatural problems can be much harder to navigate. Who do you call when you spot a fire in the veld? Who is accountable for the derelict park? Who is accountable when a government programme exists on paper but does not appear to function where people live? My response to my staff was always “Google will set you free” until someone challenged me with: “How will it?” Websites of public entities profile the political leadership and senior management, but always have a generic info@ email address. Bottom line, we have become remarkably accustomed to not knowing who to call. During a recent visit to China, one noticeable difference kept surfacing irrespective of what city I visited, what building I went into and often even the street corner I was standing at. You did not see any photographs of politicians in public buildings. What you did see were photographs of the people who were accountable. In a museum, at a public facility, even around something as ordinary as a public toilet, there would be the name and photograph of the responsible person, together with clear instructions on where to complain in both Mandarin and English. Even the local police officer responsible for an area had his picture and a complaints number. The message was clear and simple: this the person responsible. There are many things about China’s system of government that are very different from ours, and this is not an article about political systems. It is an observation about something much more basic. There is a need for accountability and responsibility to have a human address. You often hear complaints about decisions made by faceless bureaucrats. This must change, we deserve to know “where the buck stops”, “who is accountable”, and “how do I get hold of them”. I have been thinking about this increasingly while preparing for the upcoming Safety 2026 conference in Cape Town. Safety is perhaps the ultimate test of whether the government can work across boundaries. Violence, road injuries, child safety, unsafe schools, gender-based violence, dangerous public spaces and emerging digital harms do not belong neatly inside one government department. Preventing them requires health, policing, justice, education, transport, social development, local government and others to work together. As a build-up to the conference we have been working on several consensus documents designed to promote a whole-of-society, whole-of-government approach. Early in the year we attempted to identify the appropriate people in provincial and national government who should be part of these conversations. This required us to step outside our comfort zone of health and reach out to departments where we do not have an extensive contact network. The experience has been instructive, and sadly, not in a good way. Except for one province, simply trying to discover who is the responsible official was an exercise in frustration, if not futility. If you are lucky enough to track down the responsible person’s e-mail, you had to be extremely patient. In a few cases, we received responses months after they were sent; in most cases we never heard back. Many were deleted without being read (someone needs to explain to senior public servants that there is a “confirm delivery option” in Outlook that tells you when an email is deleted without being read). The owners of the info@ or enquiries@ e-mail addresses presumably have passed on. Switchboards ask you what the extension is of the person you are looking for. Clearly, internal phone books do not exist. If you eventually find someone, they will refer you to another, who suggests somebody in another department. Sometimes, months later, somebody responds. What this exercise exposed is a serious weakness in the machinery of accountability. One of our focus areas is gender-based violence and femicide (GBVF). There is no question that here, our priorities and those of government align. In November 2025, GBVF was formally classified as a national disaster under the Disaster Management Act. In his February 2026 State of the Nation Address, President Cyril Ramaphosa said the classification should enable government to better coordinate its response and direct efforts towards interventions with the greatest impact. That necessarily requires multiple departments, spheres of government and institutions to work together. So, here is my question, probably an uncomfortable question. If something is important enough to be classified as a national disaster, should it not be easy to identify and contact the people responsible for responding to this disaster? We tried and we failed. So, if an organisation like us, working nationally, and with established networks and institutional resources, struggles to identify and reach the appropriate officials, what chance does a citizen stand? Accountability cannot exist in abstract, the basics of any implementation plan in business is what, where, when and most importantly who. The who must be a person, not an abstract designation on an organogram. The who must also be easily accessible to the average citizens. This matters because visible and functional accountability is preventative. A manager who knows that performance is visible, that they are obliged to respond to correspondence, that clearing your inbox by deleting unread emails is not acceptable, that outcomes will be measured, and that failure requires explanation, behaves in a very different system from one in which responsibility can disappear into a departmental maze. There is a much simpler test that any citizen should be able to apply for every major public service, programme or priority: • Who is responsible? • How do I contact them? • When should I expect an answer? • And who do I contact if I do not get one? Imagine if every government website, clinic, police station, school and municipal facility answered those four questions clearly. Imagine if the person accountable for an outcome was as visible as the politicians in the foyers of every public building. •Dr Wolvaardt is the founder of the Foundation for Professional Development, and has recently stepped down as MD.

dz.title: المعرض الدولي للفلاحة والصناعة الغذائية بسلوفينيا إقبال كبير على الجناح الجزائري
dz.description: اقتصاد : يشهد الجناح الجزائري في المعرض الدولي للفلاحة والصناعة الغذائية "أغرا-2026" بسلوفينيا, إقبالا "كبيرا" من الزوار والمهنيين والمتعاملين الاقتصاديين, حسب ما أفاد به اليوم الأحد, بيان لوزارة التجارة الخارجية وترقية الصادرات. وأوضحت الوزارة أن زوار الجناح الجزائري خلال هذه التظاهرة الدولية المنظمة من 22 إلى 26 أوت الجاري, أبدوا اهتماما بالمنتجات الجزائرية المعروضة, لا سيما من خلال التعرف على جودتها وتنوعها وقدرتها على المنافسة في الأسواق الخارجية. وتشكل مشاركة الجزائر, ضيف شرف الطبعة, فرصة لتعزيز التواصل بين المتعاملين الاقتصاديين الجزائريين ونظرائهم الأجانب, واستكشاف فرص جديدة للشراكة والتعاون التجاري, بما يساهم في دعم وتوسيع الصادرات الجزائرية خارج المحروقات. وأشرفت على تنظيم المشاركة الجزائرية وزارة التجارة الخارجية وترقية الصادرات, بمشاركة 19 متعاملا اقتصاديا يمثلون عددا من القطاعات والمنتجات ذات الإمكانات التصديرية, وذلك في إطار تعزيز حضور المنتجات الجزائرية في الأسواق الدولية والتعريف بمقوماتها وفرصها التصديرية. وتندرج المشاركة الجزائرية في المعرض -حسب ذات المصدر- ضمن جهود وزارة التجارة الخارجية وترقية الصادرات الرامية إلى ترقية المنتج الجزائري, فتح أسواق جديدة, ومرافقة المتعاملين الاقتصاديين في الولوج إلى الأسواق الدولية.

dz.title: العاب القوى (بطولة العالم للماسترز): عبد القادر بن قلة يحصد فضية تاريخية
dz.description: رياضة : توج العداء الجزائري, عبد القادر بن قلة (92 عاما), بالميدالية الفضية في بطولة العالم للماسترز (للكهول) لألعاب القوى بمدينة دايغو الكورية الجنوبية, حسب بيان صادر عن وزارة الرياضة. وجاء في منشور لوزارة الرياضة أن "العداء الجزائري عبد القادر بن قلة, حقق إنجازا تاريخيا بإحرازه الميدالية الفضية في سباق 100 متر لفئة M90, ضمن بطولة العالم للماسترز لألعاب القوى بمدينة دايغو الكورية الجنوبية, بعدما قطع السباق في زمن قدره 18ثا و99 ج". وأشادت الوزارة بالإنجاز الذي حققه بن قلة, معتبرة أنه يجسد قوة الإرادة والعزيمة, ويؤكد أن الشغف بالرياضة لا يحده السن. وأضافت أن هذه النتيجة لا تمثل مجرد ميدالية, وإنما تحمل رسالة للأجيال بأن الرياضة لا تعترف بالعمر, وأن الإرادة والعزيمة قادرتان على صناعة الإنجاز مهما تقدم الإنسان في السن الذي يبقى مجرد رقم والإرادة لا تعرف المستحيل. ويعد ابن حي حسين داي بالعاصمة, المولود في 26 يناير 1934, أحد أبرز رموز الرياضة الجزائرية, وقد ارتبط اسمه بتاريخ الثورة التحريرية, إذ كان يعرف بلقب "الطرد البريدي" نظرا لدوره في نقل الرسائل بين المجاهدين. وعلى مدار عقود, واصل بن قلة تمثيل الجزائر في المنافسات الوطنية والقارية والدولية الخاصة برياضيي الماسترز, ونجح سنة 2025 في التتويج بلقب بطولة إفريقيا المفتوحة للماسترز التياحتضنتها تونس, بعدما سجل زمنا قدره 18 ثانية و55 جزء من المائة في سباق 100 متر, محطما الرقم القياسي الإفريقي لفئته العمرية, ليصبح أسرع عداء إفريقي فوق سن التسعين. ويختصر البطل الجزائري فلسفته في الحياة بعبارة باتت شعارا لمسيرته: "طبيبي هو المضمار", في رسالة تؤكد أن النشاط البدني المنتظم يمثل أحد أهم مفاتيح الصحة.

dz.title: وزارة الثقافة والفنون تطلق "ذاكرة النغم الجزائري" ابتداء من سبتمبر المقبل تكريما لكبار الفنانين
dz.description: ثقافة : تطلق وزارة الثقافة والفنون ابتداء من شهر سبتمبر المقبل سلسلة من الأمسيات التكريمية بعنوان "ذاكرة النغم الجزائري" احتفاء بكبار الفنانين الجزائريين, حسب ما أفاد به بيان للوزارة. وأوضح البيان أن هذه السلسلة التكريمية, التي تنظم تحت رعاية وزيرة الثقافة والفنون, مليكة بن دودة وعبر أوبرا الجزائر "بوعلام بسايح" والديوان الوطني للثقافة والإعلام, تندرج ضمن "مشروع وطني متواصل للاحتفاء بكبار الفنانين الجزائريين" و"تكريم الذين أسهموا في تشكيل الذائقة الفنية وصناعة الذاكرة الموسيقية الوطنية". وأكدت الوزارة, أن الأسماء التي تستحضرها هذه الطبعة تمثل "قائمة أولى في مسار وطني للوفاء ستواصل الوزارة توسيعه ليشمل رموزا وتجارب فنية أخرى", وذلك "صونا لذاكرة الفن الجزائري وإبقاء لأصواته الحقيقية حاضرة في الذاكرة الجماعية للجزائريين". ومن خلال هذه السلسلة التي ستتواصل إلى غاية شهر مارس 2027, يضيف البيان, سيتم "استحضار مسيرة نخبة من كبار الفنانين الذين أسهموا في صناعة تاريخ الأغنية الجزائرية, وتركوا أعمالا أصبحت جزءا من الذاكرة الجماعية ووجدان الجزائريين, على غرار الهاشمي قروابي, الشريف خدام, اعمر الزاهي, عثمان بالي, أحمد وهبي, حمدي بناني إلى جانب حسناء البشارية, بقار حدة وشريفة". كما أبرز البيان أن الأمسيات التكريمية "لا تكتفي بإعادة تقديم الأعمال الخالدة, إنما تستعيد التجارب الفنية في أبعادها الموسيقية والتاريخية والإنسانية, من خلال التوثيق, وإبراز خصوصية كل مسار, وإعادة تقديم مختارات من أشهر الأعمال برؤى موسيقية جديدة, بمشاركة نخبة من الأصوات الجزائرية والأوركسترا السيمفونية لأوبرا الجزائر", وفق المصدر.
